resources.string: Merge pieces of the same value to reach higher scores.
Numbers changed! Keep merging.

Numbers changed
Launch pieces to merge same-valued blocks
In MergeShift, pieces are launched from the dock. When a block lands on another with the same value, they merge into a higher value. Keep merging to clear space and reach higher scores.
Plan your mergers to prevent overflow
Every piece you launch adds to the column height. If any column reaches the top, the game ends. Use the preview to see where your piece will land, or open Settings to customize your experience.
Combine multiple merges for bigger combos
A single launch can trigger a chain reaction of merges. These combos award more points and clear more space on the board, helping you stay in the game longer.
You are ready for MergeShift
Focus on keeping your columns low and setting up high-value merges. Good luck reaching the highest numbers!
Launch your first piece
Drag the piece horizontally under the board to aim, then release to launch it into a column.
Merge same values vertically
Launch a piece into a column that already has a block with the same value. They will merge into a higher number!
Merge same values horizontally
Blocks can also merge with their neighbors to the left or right. Aim for the highlighted spot to trigger a horizontal merge.
Trigger multiple merges
A single placement can trigger merges in multiple directions (above, left, right). Use this to clear more space and score big!
